title: Anti-Spam & Transactional Email Policy
shortSummary: Defines rules for legitimate application email and strict prohibitions against unsolicited bulk email.

sections.heading: 1. Transactional Email Scope
paragraphs: Histeria is designed specifically for application-driven transactional emails directly triggered by user actions or critical application events.
Examples of acceptable transactional emails include account registration verification, password reset links, order receipts, shipping notifications, and critical security alerts.

sections.heading: 2. Zero-Tolerance Spam Policy
paragraphs: Histeria enforces a strict zero-tolerance policy for spam and unsolicited bulk marketing email.
Sending emails to purchased, rented, scraped, or third-party mailing lists is strictly prohibited.
High bounce rates (exceeding 5%) or complaint rates (exceeding 0.1%) will trigger automated account review and immediate delivery suspension.
